eligibility: Non-void, domain-DTO-bearing create/update business service methods in the nine deployed original JARs, with a known public HTTP route. Exclude health/welcome, void mutations, scalar acknowledgements, thin controller wrappers and helper methods without their own endpoint. Catalogue selected by API/response review, before any planner attempt.
selection: Include all declared instance fields of all five eligible methods, no acceptance-based replacement. Lists are wildcard families, not one candidate per index.
sockshop_shortfall: All remaining Cart methods return void; Orders has no unused domain response controller; remaining Shipping GETs are fixed strings. No new application/method is invented.

first_run_rules.unseal: Only after the execution-closure implementation/support declaration is frozen. Rejections/unknown/analysis_limited/evidence_invalid/N/A are retained; no test-based core change overwrites first results.
first_run_rules.input_shapes: Six cases per accepted family: create missing, duplicate/existing, update existing/missing, repeated/equal field values and boundary empty/zero cases as applicable; actual valid HTTP shapes and independent original-code truth rules fixed before first run.
first_run_rules.independent_truth: Original bytecode plus actual input/DB/RPC/object/call facts; never TF graph propagation or baseline labels. Nullable/empty output is counted by actual JSON presence, not expected success.
first_run_rules.novelty_limit: Author-selected new entries in familiar classes, not third-party blind applications. Previously used 62+29 queries are regression only.
